title: 深拷贝切断对象图：共享子对象不再共享
expected_output:
shallow copy b sees: {'owner': 'x', 'v': 1}
deep copy c independent: {'owner': 'x', 'v': 2} {'owner': 'x', 'v': 1}
code:
import copy
shared = {"owner": "x"}
a = [shared, shared]
b = copy.copy(a)          # 浅拷贝：两个元素仍指向同一 shared
c = copy.deepcopy(a)      # 深拷贝：shared 也被复制
a[0]["v"] = 1
print("shallow copy b sees:", b[0])
c[0]["v"] = 2
print("deep copy c independent:", c[0], a[0])
